_comment: Every external input to the build, pinned. Natural Earth files are fetched from one fixed commit (the v5.1.2 tag) and checked against the git blob hash recorded in that commit's tree, so a changed file can never slip in. The font zip is checked against the SHA-256 digest GitHub publishes for the release asset.

naturalEarth.licence: Public domain (Natural Earth terms of use: https://www.naturalearthdata.com/about/terms-of-use/)

pmtilesLicence._comment: The pmtiles npm package ships no LICENSE file; BSD-3 requires the notice to travel with the code, so it is taken from the upstream repo.

osmTss._comment: Snapshot of OpenStreetMap traffic-separation schemes around each strait, made by extract-osm-tss.mjs and committed. The build refuses a file whose checksum differs, so the drawn lanes only change on purpose.

osmCanals._comment: Snapshot of each canal's navigation line from OpenStreetMap, made by extract-osm-canals.mjs and committed. The build refuses a file whose checksum differs.

osmBorderLines._comment: Snapshot of the two border lines OpenStreetMap carries as geometry — the Northern Limit Line and the surviving Siegfried Line tank traps — made by extract-osm-border-lines.mjs and committed. The build refuses a file whose checksum differs, so what is drawn only changes on purpose. way/979904704 is excluded: it shares the NLL name but is the Han estuary neutral zone (left:country=Demarcation Zone).

osmPlaces._comment: Snapshot of the OpenStreetMap place nodes for headquarters towns too small for Natural Earth populated places, made by extract-osm-places.mjs and committed. Each is a place=* node found by name inside a tight bbox, never by bare name. The build refuses a file whose checksum differs.

resolveEcoregions._comment: RESOLVE Ecoregions 2017 release, used only by tools/extract-resolve.mjs; the build reads the committed extract.
resolveEcoregions.licence: CC BY 4.0 — RESOLVE Ecoregions 2017 (Dinerstein et al. 2017)

wikidataPoints._comment: P625 coordinates of the Wikidata items the Geography seeds name, from tools/extract-geography-points.mjs.

osmWaterfalls._comment: The waterfall nodes the waterfalls seed names, each checked inside its box, from tools/extract-geography-points.mjs.

codAbBangladesh._comment: OCHA Common Operational Dataset, Bangladesh administrative boundaries (source: Bangladesh Bureau of Statistics), v03, valid on 2023-05-21; HDX resource last modified 2026-01-26. Divisions and districts, joined by pcode. HDX licence field: "Creative Commons Attribution for Intergovernmental Organisations (CC BY-IGO)", http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/igo/legalcode — commercial use allowed with attribution.
codAbBangladesh.licence: CC BY-IGO 3.0 — Bangladesh Bureau of Statistics / OCHA

geoBoundariesIndia._comment: geoBoundaries gbOpen IND ADM2 (boundaryID IND-ADM2-76128533), year represented 2021, source "Pathways Data Pvt. Ltd., lgdirectory.gov.in", fixed at geoBoundaries commit 9469f09. Licence field: "Open Data Commons Open Database License 1.0" — commercial use allowed, with attribution; a database derived from it stays under ODbL. Districts only: the ADM1 file is a different dataset (DataMeet, 2011, CC BY 2.5 IN) and is not used; Tripura is the union of its districts.
geoBoundariesIndia.licence: ODbL 1.0 — geoBoundaries (Pathways Data, Local Government Directory)

osmBangladeshRivers._comment: The named major rivers of the Bangladesh basemap, from extract-bangladesh.mjs and committed; one exact-name selector per river inside its own box, the Brahmaputra family by way id. The build refuses a file whose checksum differs.

osmBangladeshLand._comment: Coastline land for the Bangladesh basemap, from extract-bangladesh.mjs and committed: OSM simplified land polygons for COVERAGE, full land polygons for the detail area. The upstream files are regenerated daily, so the files used are recorded inside the snapshot (date, size, sha256). The build refuses a file whose checksum differs.

treatyCities._comment: The Wikidata item and point of every city the environment-treaties seed names, each cited to the revision it was read at, from tools/extract-treaty-cities.mjs and committed. The build refuses a file whose checksum differs, so a marker only moves on purpose.

nasaBlueMarble._comment: The latitude-longitude globe's imagery, tiled by tools/build-latitude-longitude-imagery.mjs, which refuses a file whose SHA-256 differs. Equirectangular, the whole Earth, 5400 × 2700 px (8 km/pixel). The terms below are quoted from NASA's own pages, read 2026-09-27; each rule is what the map must do.
nasaBlueMarble.product: Blue Marble: Next Generation — July, with topography and bathymetry (world.topo.bathy.200407), 5400 × 2700
nasaBlueMarble.licence: NASA — free to re-use, commercial use included, no copyright indicated; credit "NASA Earth Observatory"

credit.rule: Credit "NASA Earth Observatory", in ⓘ, linked to the product's page.
credit.states: Anyone using or republishing Blue Marble: Next Generation please credit “NASA Earth Observatory.”

reuse.rule: Re-use is allowed, commercial use included; none of the product's pages indicates a copyright.
reuse.states: Most materials published under science.nasa.gov/earth, including images, are freely available for re-publication or re-use, including commercial purposes, except for where copyright is indicated.

endorsement.rule: No wording that suggests NASA endorses the map or the app.
endorsement.states: If the NASA material is to be used for commercial purposes, including advertisements, it must not explicitly or implicitly convey NASA’s endorsement of commercial goods or services.

logo.rule: No NASA logo, insignia or logotype.
logo.states: The use of the Insignia, Logotype and NASA identifiers is protected by law, and imagery is made available for use consistent with Media Usage Guidelines.

osmLiberationPoints._comment: The OpenStreetMap elements liberation-war-1971 takes where its sources give no point of the place itself (sector HQs, places, a grave), each matched by name inside its COD-AB upazila or district (or a box round the Indian district its source names), by type, id and version, from tools/extract-liberation-points.mjs. Only a deliberate re-run changes it.

osmBangladeshRiversPilot._comment: The OpenStreetMap ways the Rivers of Bangladesh picture draws beyond the rivers snapshot (osmBangladeshRivers): the Padma and Meghna continuation, the Old Brahmaputra's connecting ways, Teesta and Karatoya ways the snapshot lacks, and the Dharla, Atrai, Dhaleshwari, Banshi and Shitalakshya courses — each by way id, with node ids and tags, from tools/extract-bangladesh-rivers-pilot.mjs. Only a deliberate re-run changes it.

osmBangladeshRiversPadma._comment: The OpenStreetMap ways the Rivers of Bangladesh picture's Padma system draws beyond the rivers snapshot and the pilot extract — the Gorai, the Arial Khan, the Mahananda and one Bhagirathi way — each by way id, with node ids and tags, from tools/extract-bangladesh-rivers-system.mjs padma (the way list is the system seed's geometry.extract). Every way carries a name, name:bn, name:en or wikidata tag naming its river (the user's rule, 2026-09-29). Only a deliberate re-run changes it.

osmBangladeshRiversKarnaphuli._comment: The OpenStreetMap ways the Rivers of Bangladesh picture's Karnaphuli system draws beyond the rivers snapshot — the Kasalong and the Halda — each by way id, with node ids and tags, from tools/extract-bangladesh-rivers-system.mjs karnaphuli (the way list is the system seed's geometry.extract). Every way carries a name, name:bn, name:en or wikidata tag naming its river (the user's rule, 2026-09-29). Only a deliberate re-run changes it.

osmBangladeshRiversPadmaB2._comment: The OpenStreetMap ways the Rivers of Bangladesh picture's Padma system draws in Stage 2 batch b2 (the south-west: Mathabhanga, Kumar, Bhairab, Kapotaksha, Nabaganga, Chitra), each by way id, with node ids and tags, from tools/extract-bangladesh-rivers-system.mjs padma b2 (the way list is the Padma seed's geometry.extractBatches.b2). Every way carries a name, name:bn, name:en or wikidata tag naming its river (the user's rule, 2026-09-29). Only a deliberate re-run changes it.

osmBangladeshRiversMeghnaB3._comment: The OpenStreetMap ways the Rivers of Bangladesh picture's Meghna system draws in Stage 2 batch b3 beyond the rivers snapshot — the Barak and the Titas — each by way id, with node ids and tags, from tools/extract-bangladesh-rivers-system.mjs meghna b3 (the way list is the Meghna seed's geometry.extractBatches.b3). Every way carries a name, name:bn, name:en or wikidata tag naming its river (the user's rule, 2026-09-29). Only a deliberate re-run changes it.

osmBangladeshRiversMeghnaB4._comment: The OpenStreetMap ways the Rivers of Bangladesh picture's Meghna system draws in Stage 2 batch b4 — the Manu, the Gumti and the Khowai — each by way id, with node ids and tags, from tools/extract-bangladesh-rivers-system.mjs meghna b4 (the way list is the Meghna seed's geometry.extractBatches.b4). Every way carries a name, name:bn, name:en or wikidata tag naming its river, except the group «evidence»: four unnamed ways chosen as members of the Gumti's relation 12567907 «Gomati» (the user's rule allows relation membership). Only a deliberate re-run changes it.

osmBangladeshRiversJamunaB4._comment: The OpenStreetMap way the Rivers of Bangladesh picture's Jamuna system draws in Stage 2 batch b4 — the Buriganga — by way id, with node ids and tags, from tools/extract-bangladesh-rivers-system.mjs jamuna b4 (the way list is the Jamuna seed's geometry.extractBatches.b4). Only a deliberate re-run changes it.

osmBangladeshRiversPadmaB7._comment: The OpenStreetMap ways the Rivers of Bangladesh picture’s Padma system draws in Stage 3 batch b7 — the Punarbhaba, the Pagla and the Tangon, the Mahananda’s tributaries — each by way id, with node ids and tags, from tools/extract-bangladesh-rivers-system.mjs padma b7 (the way list is the Padma seed’s geometry.extractBatches.b7). Every way carries a name, name:bn, name:en or wikidata tag naming its river. Only a deliberate re-run changes it.
